commands.name: desk-preview
commands.description: Lay a Markdown document out in the preview pane beside the conversation, drawn like the transcript (no file: the last one previewed)
commands.output: Nothing previewed yet. Open one with /desk-preview <file>.

commands.name: desk-sessions
commands.description: Open the recent sessions pane, like the desktop sidebar (give a number to switch to that session)

commands.name: desk-diff
commands.description: Open the diff pane on the right, like the desktop app (give a file name to open at it, or branch / commits for that scope)

commands.name: desk-pr
commands.description: Open the current branch's PR (GitHub) or MR (GitLab) with checks and unresolved reviews (needs gh or glab)

commands.name: desk-asana
commands.description: Open the Asana tasks assigned to you, and your projects' tasks by section, in a pane: details, comments, adding a comment, assignee and dropdown fields (needs an Asana MCP server)
commands.output: No Asana MCP server is connected. Connect Asana in /mcp.

commands.name: desk-slack
commands.description: Open the Slack DMs and group DMs sent to you as conversations in a pane: recent messages, replying, closing, and a notification for new ones (needs a Slack MCP server)
commands.output: No Slack MCP server is connected. Connect Slack in /mcp.

commands.name: desk-context
commands.description: Open context usage by category, with usage limits and cost

commands.name: desk-tasks
commands.description: Open this session's agents, background shells and monitors, like the desktop Background tasks (give a number for that task's details)

commands.name: desk-fold
commands.description: Fold the open desk-look panes away so the conversation takes the width; run it again to unfold them where they were
commands.output: Folded 7 panes. Run /desk-fold again to unfold.

commands.name: desk-quote
commands.description: Put the text you selected in the conversation into the prompt as a quote

commands.name: desk-update
commands.description: Update desk-look to the latest version from its marketplace (then /reload-plugins)

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Opens a Markdown file in desk-look's preview pane beside the conversation, drawn like the transcript (tables, mermaid diagrams, alert boxes). Use it when the person asks to see, read or preview a .md file. A document you write during a turn opens by itself when the turn ends; you do not need to call this after writing one.
